records.researcher_notes: Aggregators say the site could add another 60 MW. I found no permit, interconnection filing or company document that gives a status for a new generating unit. The city extended its data center moratorium in June 2026. The company says it targets conversion of its New York sites from the third and fourth quarters of 2027. So this is still only talk. Recheck after the moratorium vote comes up again.

records.researcher_notes: Alpha Generation, owned by an ArcLight affiliate, proposed on March 16, 2026 to replace six peaking units on barges at the Gowanus and Narrows stations in Brooklyn with three new lower-emission gas units. It answered a Con Edison search for ways to meet a New York City reliability need. The press release does not give megawatts or a start date, and a trade press report says state regulators asked for non-emitting options only. The existing barge stations are not in GEM's New York list that I checked. No air permit has been filed that I found. Check whether the old units are in scope, and recheck once Con Edison or the Public Service Commission picks solutions.
